author.name: Sydney J. Harris
author.heading: About Sydney J. Harris
author.bio: Sydney J. Harris wrote the syndicated Strictly Personal newspaper column and collected many of his essays in books. His 1969 argument that a person makes a self through daily actions is an early documented relative of this modern saying, rather than proof that he coined its exact wording.

context.heading: Why it mattered
lead: The early Harris passage pushes back against the idea of a fixed inner identity waiting to be discovered. He emphasizes repeated actions rather than introspection; the later two-sentence slogan keeps that contrast but drops the explanation of how a self is made.
